nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 20 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations (11:06 WAT and a 23 Nov dated source without intraday time), verified 11:50 WAT on 23 Nov. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
